title: fix(service-messaging): a GET or HEAD delivery through the HTTP outbox sends no body and is signed over what it sends
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #33895
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：消息 HTTP 发件箱投递 GET/HEAD 请求时不再带请求体，签名改为对实际发出的内容（空串）计算；SQL 与内存两种发件箱在入队时都按方法签名。GET/HEAD 若携带真实请求体，入队时直接拒绝（发件箱绝不静默丢弃数据）；已存的此类行在发送时同样拒绝且不重试。
- 为什么改：持久化 http 节点写 `method: 'GET'` 时，发件箱总是发送 `'{}'`，`fetch` 拒绝带请求体的 GET，投递一直重试直到死亡。18.5.0 说明里推荐的 `method: 'GET'` 写法在有发件箱时根本不可用。
- 风险与回滚：POST 等其他方法行为不变；导出类型 `FetchImpl` 的 `init.body` 变为可选。带正文的 GET 由「入队后死信」变为「入队即拒绝」：http 节点报 `failed to enqueue`，GET 方法的 Webhook 只记一条丢失事件的 error 日志、不写投递行，记录本身的保存不受影响（这类 Webhook 在 main 上本来就从未送达，契约层面的处理见 #34098）。修复前已入队的 GET/HEAD 行仍带旧签名。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts`（`deliveryBody`、`assertBodylessPayloadAdmitted` 与 `sendOnce` 的无请求体分支）、两个发件箱的 `enqueue`、新测试 `http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts`，预期 19 个用例全部通过（含真实本地接收端的 GET/HEAD 投递、sqlite 发件箱签名与拒绝）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `http-sender.ts`: `deliveryBody(payload, method?)` answers `''` for GET and HEAD. `sendOnce` sends a GET or HEAD with no `body` key and without the default `Content-Type: application/json`. Every other method sends exactly what it sent before.
- `http-sender.ts`: new `bodylessPayloadRefusal(method, payload)` and `assertBodylessPayloadAdmitted(input)`. A GET or HEAD whose payload is a real body is refused with an error that names the method and the fix (use POST or PUT, or drop the body). Admitted payloads: absent, `null`, and an empty plain `{}` (the shape a durable `http` node with no `body` enqueues). `sendOnce` applies the same refusal to a stored row that bypassed enqueue (legacy or redelivered) as a non-retriable failure, so the row goes `dead` with that error and `fetch` is never called. The outbox never drops bytes on any path.
- `sql-http-outbox.ts` and `memory-http-outbox.ts`: `enqueue` calls the refusal after `assertEnqueueDeliverable` and before signing; the enqueue-time signature is computed over `deliveryBody(input.payload, input.method)`, so a GET or HEAD is signed over the empty string, the bytes it sends.
- The exported `FetchImpl` type: `init.body` is optional. Seven test fetch recorders (four in service-messaging, three in plugin-webhooks) store `init.body ?? ''`, the bytes on the wire.
- `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`: comment only, with its own patch changeset.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/service-messaging` naming the refusal, the `FetchImpl` type change, and rows at rest.

## Tests

`http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts` (new, 19 cases):
- GET, HEAD and lowercase `get` through `MemoryHttpOutbox` and `HttpDispatcher`: no `body` key, no `Content-Type`, signature over `''` verified by `verifyHttpSignature`, row `success` after one attempt.
- GET and HEAD to a real `node:http` receiver on 127.0.0.1 through the real global `fetch`: delivered once, body `''`, signature verifies.
- `SqlHttpOutbox` on sqlite: GET and HEAD signed over the empty body and delivered; GET `{a:1}` refused with no row stored; GET `{}` admitted.
- Refusal: `MemoryHttpOutbox` refuses GET `{a:1}`, HEAD `'raw'`, `get` `[1]` and GET `''`, writing no row; admits GET with `undefined`, `null` and `{}`.
- A stored GET row with a real payload fails at `sendOnce` with `retriable: false` and no fetch call.
- CONTROL: a POST `{a:1}` is admitted and sends its JSON body with `Content-Type: application/json`, signed over those bytes.

## Acceptance notes

1. The area widened the file surface (claim amendment 6897279605). Each test recorder records `init.body ?? ''` at its push site rather than widening its element type, which would cascade into about 25 `createHmac(...).update(calls[0].body)` sites.
2. A GET or HEAD whose payload is a real body is refused at enqueue (http node: `failed to enqueue`; webhook: lost-event error log, record write unaffected), and a stored row holding one fails at send; the outbox never drops bytes. The webhook path was measured with a throwaway probe on the real `AutoEnqueuer` + `MessagingService.enqueueHttp` + `MemoryHttpOutbox`: no throw into the publisher, no unhandled rejection, zero rows, one say-once error line. The auto-enqueuer calls `enqueue` fire-and-forget (`auto-enqueuer.ts` L1241, L1398), so the record save is untouched. Whether GET belongs in the webhook contract at all is ruled on #34098 (remove it), built separately. Until #34098 lands, a GET webhook leaves only that log line, so the two should ship in the same release.

   Clause-② no, and why: `IHttpOutbox`, `EnqueueHttpInput`, both outboxes and `MessagingService` are published from the package entry, so the enqueue door is public. It is still not a narrowing, because the refused set is exactly what `fetch` already killed at send on every wired path; the refusal only moves from send to enqueue.
3. Rows at rest are not rewritten: rows enqueued as signed GET/HEAD keep the signature computed over their payload's bytes (the secret is not stored), so a verifying receiver refuses them. They never delivered before this fix either. The changeset tells the operator to re-run the flow.

Restored to blob `772eb533` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Send-time refusal: replacing the send-time return with `void refusal;` gave Tests 1 failed, 18 passed (19); the stored-row case went red. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- GET pin (on `439f01b0`, `http-sender.ts` bodyless arm then byte-identical): replacing `...(bodyless ? {} : { body }),` with `body,` gave Tests 5 failed, 2 passed (7).
